recognize_zh: 淋巴球核有角、染色質粗且深染，箭頭處核與細胞質交界有一條細長、透明無色的線狀結構，為細胞質內結晶；細胞質淡且邊緣不規則，右下角另有一顆較大的顆粒性細胞可作大小對照。
features: Dense, coarsely clumped chromatin; no nucleoli
Moderate pale cytoplasm with irregular, slightly scalloped outline
Thin colorless crystalline sliver at the nuclear-cytoplasmic interface (arrow)
Partially visible larger granulated cell at lower right; normochromic red cells
describe_en: High-power view of a peripheral blood smear shows a lymphocyte with an angulated nucleus, dense coarsely clumped chromatin and a moderate rim of pale cytoplasm with an irregular border. A thin, unstained, linear crystalline inclusion lies along the nuclear margin (arrow). A larger granulated cell is partially visible at the edge, and red cells are normochromic. Findings are consistent with a crystalline inclusion in a malignant lymphocyte; demonstration in multiple cells and immunophenotyping help exclude artifact and classify the lymphoproliferative disorder.

ddx.vs: Auer rods are stained reddish-purple rods in myeloblasts, not colorless inclusions in mature lymphoid cells.

ddx.dx: Artifactual cleft between nucleus and cytoplasm
ddx.vs: Retraction clefts are irregular and common in thick areas, whereas crystals have sharp, straight parallel edges.
Sézary cells show cerebriform, grooved nuclei and may have perinuclear vacuoles but lack rod-shaped crystals.
